items.name: ref
items.prompt: The cast and props of a modern mystery novel, cute but a little noir, in a palette of midnight navy, streetlight mustard yellow, tomato red, cream and teal: (1) a young woman detective with a short bob, a mustard trench coat and a magnifying glass; (2) a nervous young man suspect in a grey hoodie and jeans, sweat drops on his forehead; (3) an elderly lady witness with round glasses, a lilac cardigan and a ginger cat in her arms; (4) a gruff middle-aged police inspector with a big mustache, a rumpled brown suit and a paper coffee cup; (5) a modern paperback mystery novel whose cover shows a rainy night street, a streetlamp and a fedora silhouette; (6) a silver laptop with colourful sound waves on its screen; (7) a smartphone playing an audiobook; (8) big over-ear headphones in teal and cream. Everyone in modern clothes. No text.

items.name: novel
items.prompt: The modern paperback mystery novel from the model sheet, standing slightly open and tilted, its cover a rainy night street with a glowing streetlamp, a fedora silhouette and a magnifying glass. No readable words or letters anywhere.

items.name: detective
items.prompt: The young woman detective from the model sheet (short bob, mustard trench coat), full body, standing facing front, holding up the magnifying glass to one eye with a sharp, confident look.

items.name: suspect
items.prompt: The nervous young man suspect from the model sheet (grey hoodie, jeans), full body, standing facing front, both hands raised defensively, sweat drops flying, eyes wide.

items.name: witness
items.prompt: The elderly lady witness from the model sheet (round glasses, lilac cardigan), full body, standing facing front, holding the ginger cat in her arms, mouth open in an excited whisper.

items.name: inspector
items.prompt: The gruff police inspector from the model sheet (big mustache, rumpled brown suit), full body, standing facing front, holding the paper coffee cup up, one eyebrow raised.

items.name: laptop
items.prompt: The silver laptop from the model sheet, open, seen from the front, its screen showing colourful sound waves in tomato red, mustard and teal on a dark background. No logo, no text.

items.name: phone
items.prompt: The smartphone from the model sheet, standing upright, its screen showing an audiobook player: a small square cover with a rainy night street, a progress bar, a big round play button and a short list of chapter rows drawn as plain bars. No readable text.

items.name: headphones
items.prompt: The big over-ear headphones from the model sheet, teal and cream, seen from the front, a few small musical-note doodles around them.

items.name: bg_rain
items.prompt: A city street on a rainy night: a deep midnight-navy sky with soft diagonal rain streaks, the warm glow of a streetlamp at the far right edge, the dark silhouettes of buildings with a few lit windows along the left edge, and a wet pavement with yellow reflections along the bottom edge. The middle is calm and dark.

items.name: bg_board
items.prompt: A detective's cork pinboard filling the frame: warm brown cork texture, a few blank index cards and a street map scrap pinned only near the corners and edges, no strings, no photos, no text. The middle is plain cork.

items.name: bg_desk
items.prompt: A quiet desk at night: a deep navy watercolor wall with a window of rain at the far left edge, the warm round glow of a desk lamp at the far right edge, and a wooden desk top along the bottom edge. The middle is plain and calm.

items.name: who.en
items.prompt: A hand-lettered cartoon title that reads exactly "Who said that?" (three words and a question mark, nothing else), on one line. Chunky bold letters in mustard yellow, cream and tomato red with a dark navy outline, a little magnifying glass forming the dot of the question mark. Spell it exactly.

items.name: who.zh
items.prompt: 一个手绘卡通标题，文字必须准确为「这句话是谁说的？」（七个汉字加问号，不要其他文字），排成一行。粗壮的字体，颜色用芥末黄、奶油白和番茄红，外面一圈深蓝描边；问号的圆点画成一个小放大镜。字必须写对。

items.name: audiobooks.en
items.prompt: A hand-lettered cartoon title that reads exactly "Multi-voice audiobooks" (two words, nothing else), on two lines: "Multi-voice" above "audiobooks". Chunky bold letters in mustard yellow, cream, tomato red and teal with a dark navy outline, little sound waves flowing from the last letter. Spell it exactly, including the hyphen.

items.name: audiobooks.zh
items.prompt: 一个手绘卡通标题，文字必须准确为「多角色有声书」（六个汉字，不要其他文字），排成一行。粗壮的字体，颜色用芥末黄、奶油白、番茄红和青色，外面一圈深蓝描边，最后一个字旁边飘出声波。字必须写对。
